heading.en: What happens, step by step — and why.

body.mr: बाहेरून पाहता IVF गोंधळात टाकणारं वाटू शकतं. प्रत्यक्षात ते जसं घडतं, ते सहा टप्पे इथे सोप्या भाषेत.
body.en: IVF can feel overwhelming from the outside. Here are the six steps as they actually unfold, in plain language.

body.mr: एक हळुवार सुरुवात. सौम्य औषधं तुमच्या अंडाशयांना नेहमीपेक्षा जास्त स्त्री बीजे तयार करायला मदत करतात, आणि प्रत्येक तपासणीत काळजीपूर्वक लक्ष ठेवलं जातं.
body.en: A gentle head start. Light medication helps your ovaries prepare more eggs than usual, with care at every check-in.

body.mr: भूल देऊन केली जाणारी एक छोटी, प्रक्रिया. तयार झालेली स्त्री बीजे हळुवारपणे गोळा केली जातात — बहुतेकांना फार थोडासा त्रास जाणवतो.
body.en: A short, calm procedure under anesthesia. The matured eggs are gently collected — most people feel only mild discomfort.

body.mr: प्रयोगशाळेत egg आणि sperm एकत्र आणले जातात.
body.en: In the lab, egg and sperm are brought together — the quiet beginning of a possible embryo.

body.mr: काही दिवसांत embryos वाढतात, आणि सर्वात निरोगी embryo काळजीपूर्वक निवडला जातो.
body.en: Over a few days, embryos develop under close watch, and the healthiest is chosen with care.

body.mr: एक झटपट, वेदनारहित टप्पा. Embryo हळुवारपणे गर्भाशयात ठेवला जातो — भूल नाही, बेड रेस्टची गरज नाही.
body.en: A quick, painless step. The embryo is gently placed in the womb — no anesthesia, no bed rest needed.

body.mr: टेस्टपर्यंत साधारण दोन आठवडे. सर्वात कठीण प्रतीक्षा — आणि तीच आम्ही तुमच्यासोबत पार करतो.
body.en: About two weeks until the test. The hardest wait — and the one we walk through with you.

body.mr: उपचार सुरू होईपर्यंत तुम्हाला प्रत्येक टप्पा समजलेला असेल — आणि हीच स्पष्टता सगळं बदलते.
body.en: By the time treatment begins, you’ll understand every step — and that clarity changes everything.

heading.mr: इथे तुम्ही फक्त एक केस नंबर नसाल.
heading.en: You won’t be a case number here.

body.mr: वीस वर्षांहून अधिक काळ, दोन डॉक्टर — आणि एक ध्येय — यांनी स्वतःला एकाच गोष्टीला वाहून घेतलं आहे: दाम्पत्यांना प्रामाणिकपणे आणि आपुलकीने आई-बाबा होण्यासाठी मदत करणं. तुमच्यासोबत चालणाऱ्या माणसांना भेटा.
body.en: For over twenty years, two doctors — and a marriage — have devoted themselves to one thing: helping couples become parents, with honesty and care. Meet the people who’ll walk beside you.

intro.en: Gorakh believes no one should feel lost in their own treatment. He’ll sit with you, draw the picture, and answer every question — twice if you need — until the fear gives way to understanding.

body.en: If something here has been on your mind, you’re not alone — these are the things couples ask us most. Honest answers, in plain language.

question.mr: IVF मधून जन्मलेली बाळं इतर बाळांइतकीच निरोगी असतात का?
question.en: Are IVF babies as healthy as other babies?

answer.mr: होय. जगभरात IVF मधून लाखो निरोगी मुलं जन्माला आली आहेत. IVF बाळ इतर कोणत्याही बाळाइतकंच निरोगी — आणि तितकंच लाडकं — असतं.
answer.en: Yes. Millions of healthy children have been born through IVF worldwide. An IVF baby is just as healthy — and just as loved — as any other.

question.mr: IVF म्हणजे नेहमी जुळीच बाळं का?

answer.mr: आता नाही. आम्ही सहसा एकच निरोगी embryo ट्रान्सफर करतो, त्यामुळे बहुतेक IVF गर्भधारणांमध्ये एकच बाळ असतं.
answer.en: Not anymore. We usually transfer a single healthy embryo, so most IVF pregnancies are a single baby.

answer.mr: बहुतेकांना फक्त थोडासा त्रास जाणवतो. स्त्री बीजे गोळा करण्याचा टप्पा भूल देऊन केला जातो, त्यामुळे त्या वेळी वेदना जाणवत नाहीत.
answer.en: Most people feel only mild discomfort. The egg-collection step is done under anesthesia, so you won’t feel pain during it.

question.mr: IVF फक्त स्त्रीशीच संबंधित असतं का?
question.en: Is IVF only about the woman?

answer.mr: नाही. प्रजननातील अडचणी तितक्याच वेळा पुरुषाशी — किंवा दोघांशी — संबंधित असतात. आम्ही संपूर्ण चित्र एकत्रितपणे पाहतो, कुणालाही दोष न देता.
answer.en: No. Fertility challenges are just as often related to the man — or both partners. We look at the whole picture, together, without blame.

answer.mr: हो, ते सर्वात महत्त्वाच्या घटकांपैकी एक आहे — आणि म्हणूनच लवकर पर्याय समजून घेतल्याने तुम्हाला सर्वाधिक पर्याय मिळतात. पण प्रत्येकाची कहाणी वेगळी असते, आणि 40 म्हणजे बंद दरवाजा नाही.
answer.en: It’s one of the most important factors — which is exactly why understanding your options early gives you the most choices. But every story is different, and 40 is not a closed door.

question.mr: Embryo transfer नंतर मला पूर्ण बेड रेस्ट घ्यावी लागते का?
question.en: Do I need complete bed rest after the embryo transfer?

body.en: Fertility care should begin with time to listen, space to understand, and honest guidance about what comes next.

title.en: When the path feels uncertain, understanding is a form of care.

paragraphs.en: Many couples arrive with more questions than answers. They may have spent months reading, waiting, or hearing advice that does not fit their story. Before another recommendation is made, they deserve to understand what their evaluation means.

IVF Master was conceived as a place for education as much as treatment: a place to explain fertility medicine in plain language, correct misconceptions, and help couples make informed decisions without pressure.
That belief shapes the clinical relationship. The team listens first, explains what is known, speaks honestly about what remains uncertain, and only then discusses the care that may be appropriate.

quote.en: Hope is most useful when it comes with clarity.

note.en: The original purpose of IVF Master was to educate couples about IVF and remove misconceptions around treatment.

title.en: A plan is built with you, not handed to you.

intro.en: The medical work matters. So does the order in which it happens.

body.en: Your history, concerns, previous treatment, health, and hopes provide the context that tests alone cannot.
Evaluation may include ovarian reserve testing, semen analysis, uterine assessment, and lifestyle guidance. Each finding is explained before it becomes a decision.
Age, diagnosis, medical history, time trying to conceive, and individual priorities all influence which next step makes sense.
Questions do not stop when treatment starts. Support continues through monitoring, procedures, the waiting period, and pregnancy care where appropriate.

eyebrow.en: Two doctors, one continuity of care

pullQuote.en: Experience matters most when it helps someone feel less lost.

paragraphs.en: For Dr. Gorakh Mandrupkar, reproductive medicine has always involved two responsibilities: practising it carefully and making it understandable. He has worked as a consultant in reproductive medicine since March 2006, building more than two decades of experience around the questions couples bring into the consultation room.

His academic path includes a Pune University Gold Medal in Gynecology in 2004. Over time, that foundation expanded into clinical care for more than 2,000 couples, research in women's health, and more than ten years directing a FOGSI-recognized IVF training centre, where gynecologists train in IUI and IVF techniques.

The same practical curiosity led him to develop the HDP Gestosis Score, a screening tool for women at risk of preeclampsia that was adopted for clinical use by India's National Health Mission. He also serves as an honorary member on national committees of the Government of India and leading national associations of gynecologists. At the clinic, research and teaching are not separate from patient care; they shape how evidence is questioned, explained, and applied to each couple.

evidence.en: Clinical practice, research, and teaching are treated as one responsibility: improving the quality of the next decision.

pullQuote.en: Care should remain steady when the journey becomes complex.

paragraphs.en: Dr. Saie Mandrupkar completed her postgraduate degree in Obstetrics and Gynecology from Pune University in 2005. Across more than two decades of clinical work, she has cared for women through infertility evaluation, fertility treatment, high-risk pregnancy, and the transition toward safe motherhood.

Her experience includes IVF pregnancies, recurrent pregnancy loss, pregnancies complicated by diabetes or hypertension, and other complex maternal and fetal conditions. She has helped more than 2,000 couples through infertility care, while remaining attentive to the emotional weight carried alongside the medical details.

Her participation in clinical research helps keep that care connected to current evidence. Just as importantly, her work creates continuity: the person who understands the uncertainty before treatment can remain present through the vulnerable stages that may follow.

evidence.en: Continuity matters: fertility treatment and high-risk pregnancy care are understood as connected parts of one reproductive journey.

title.en: Good care is never the work of one person.

intro.en: An IVF journey moves between conversations, monitoring, medication, procedures, laboratory work, and waiting. The experience feels more manageable when those moments belong to one coordinated team.

body.en: Questions about preparation, medication, monitoring, and recovery need clear answers at the moment they arise.
After egg retrieval, the embryology team manages fertilisation and embryo development with careful observation over the days that follow.
The waiting period can be difficult. Support includes making space for anxiety, questions, and the need to move through treatment one step at a time.

title.en: What you can expect from the relationship.

intro.en: Trust is not a claim made once. It is built through the way each conversation, recommendation, and uncertainty is handled.

body.en: A treatment plan follows an understanding of reproductive health, medical history, age, and the couple's circumstances.

Care continues through treatment questions, the waiting period, follow-up, and pregnancy management when it is needed.

metaTitle.en: About IVF Master - Care, Clarity & Reproductive Medicine

metaDescription.mr: IVF Master मधील डॉक्टर आणि टीमला भेटा आणि ऐकणे, शिक्षण व पुराव्यावर आधारित उपचार प्रत्येक प्रजनन प्रवासाला कशी दिशा देतात ते जाणून घ्या.
metaDescription.en: Meet the doctors and care team behind IVF Master and learn how listening, education and evidence shape each fertility journey.

oneLiner.en: The complete journey — eggs and sperm meet in the lab, and the healthiest embryo comes home to you.

heroDescription.en: IVF is the most comprehensive fertility treatment we offer — a careful, step-by-step process that gives many couples their best chance at pregnancy. Every decision is personal, every plan is tailored, and we will walk with you through each stage.

whatToExpect.en: You will have a handful of monitoring visits during stimulation — typically every two to three days. Most people experience mild bloating or tenderness from the hormones, and brief discomfort at egg retrieval. The two-week wait is emotionally the hardest part for many couples, but most continue normal daily life throughout the rest of the process.

whoItsFor.en: Blocked or damaged fallopian tubes
Low sperm count or poor motility
Endometriosis affecting fertility
Unexplained infertility after simpler treatments
When previous fertility treatments have not worked
Couples who want embryos screened for genetic conditions before transfer

detail.en: A brief round of blood tests, an ultrasound, and sometimes a semen assessment — nothing invasive. Just enough for us to understand your situation and build a plan that is personal to you.

Daily hormone injections for around 10–14 days encourage your ovaries to mature several eggs at once. You will come in for gentle monitoring scans every few days so we can see how things are developing and adjust if needed.

A short procedure under light sedation, guided by ultrasound. Most patients are home within a couple of hours and comfortable enough to rest at home the same day. The discomfort is brief and well managed.

Your eggs and your partner's (or a donor's) prepared sperm are brought together in the laboratory. Where it helps, we use ICSI — a single sperm is injected carefully into each egg. The embryos are then watched closely as they develop over 3–6 days.

The healthiest embryo is gently placed into your uterus through a thin, soft catheter. No anaesthesia needed, very little discomfort, and no bed rest required afterwards. You can go home the same hour.
Supportive progesterone helps prepare the lining of your uterus. Around 13–15 days after the transfer, a blood test tells you the result. We remain available to you through every day of the wait.

q.en: How many embryos will be transferred?

a.en: In most cases, one healthy embryo is transferred at a time. This reduces the chance of a multiple pregnancy while still giving a strong chance of success. Two may be considered in specific circumstances, and we will always discuss this with you first.

q.en: What happens to embryos we do not use?

a.en: Extra embryos of good quality can be frozen using vitrification and stored safely for a future cycle — so you may not need to go through stimulation again. They can also be donated to other couples or to research, or allowed to reach their natural end. Your team will talk through all the options with you.

q.en: How many cycles might we need?

a.en: This is genuinely variable and depends on your age, embryo quality, and the underlying reason for infertility. Some couples succeed on the first cycle; others need two or three. We give you an honest, personal picture at the very start so you can plan.

oneLiner.en: A simpler, gentler first step — well-timed sperm meets egg with a little help from us.

heroDescription.en: IUI is often where fertility treatment begins. It is a gentler, less intensive option that gives your body a well-timed helping hand. For the right couples, it can be an effective first step before considering anything more involved.

whatToExpect.en: IUI is much less intensive than IVF — fewer clinic visits, no injections for most patients, and a very brief procedure on the day. You may feel mild cramp-like discomfort for a short time after the insemination. Success rates per cycle are lower than IVF, which is why couples often try a few cycles before deciding on next steps.

whoItsFor.en: Unexplained infertility at an earlier stage
Mild male factor — slightly reduced count or motility
Cervical mucus that may be preventing sperm from reaching the egg
Couples who want to try a gentler option before IVF
Single women or same-sex couples using donor sperm
Ovulation disorders supported with light medication

detail.en: A scan or two to track your natural ovulation, or light hormone tablets to support it. For most IUI patients there are no injections — just careful monitoring to find the right moment.

On the day of the procedure, your partner provides a sample. Our laboratory washes and concentrates the most active, motile sperm over about two hours — a simple, standard process that makes a real difference.

A thin, flexible catheter places the prepared sperm gently into your uterus just as you are ovulating. The procedure takes a few minutes and is usually painless — most patients describe it as a mild internal sensation.

Normal activities can resume immediately. There is nothing you need to change. A blood test or home test about two weeks later gives you the result, and we are here if you want to talk through how you are feeling.

a.en: For most people, no. The insemination itself is similar to a smear test — brief and usually painless. Some patients feel mild cramping for a short time afterwards, but this passes quickly and you can carry on with your day straight away.

q.en: How many cycles of IUI should we try before moving on?

a.en: Most clinics recommend three to six cycles before discussing other options — but this depends on your age and individual picture. We will talk with you honestly after each cycle and will never push you to continue if the evidence suggests a different path might serve you better.

oneLiner.en: A single, carefully selected sperm injected directly into each egg — precision where it matters most.

heroDescription.en: ICSI is a precise technique used alongside IVF when sperm needs extra support to fertilise an egg. It works within the same cycle as standard IVF — the difference happens in the laboratory, in the skilled hands of our embryology team.

whatToExpect.en: From your perspective as a patient, ICSI feels identical to a standard IVF cycle. The additional precision happens in the lab, not to you. Fertilisation rates with ICSI are significantly higher when sperm quality is the primary challenge, and long-term outcomes for children are comparable to those from standard IVF.

whoItsFor.en: Low sperm count (oligospermia)
Poor sperm motility — sperm that struggle to swim
Abnormal sperm shape affecting fertilisation
Sperm retrieved surgically where there is no sperm in the ejaculate
Previous IVF cycles where fertilisation did not occur
Couples wanting the highest chance of fertilisation per egg collected

detail.en: Exactly the same as a standard IVF cycle — light hormone stimulation to grow several eggs, gentle monitoring visits, then a short egg-collection procedure under light sedation. The ICSI difference begins in the laboratory.

In the laboratory, an embryologist uses a high-powered microscope and a fine glass needle to select one healthy sperm and inject it directly into each mature egg. This step bypasses the natural fertilisation barrier entirely.
The fertilised eggs are watched closely in the incubator over 3–5 days as they develop into embryos. Our team grades them carefully and keeps you updated on progress each day.
The strongest embryo is transferred to your uterus in exactly the same gentle way as in a standard IVF cycle — a thin soft catheter, no anaesthesia, and no bed rest needed afterwards.

a.en: ICSI dramatically improves the chance of fertilisation when sperm quality is the challenge, but no technique can guarantee it. Your embryology team will keep you updated on how your embryos are developing each day.

q.en: Is ICSI riskier than standard IVF?

a.en: ICSI has been used successfully for over 30 years. Extensive research shows that outcomes for children are comparable to standard IVF. We recommend ICSI only when it is genuinely in your interest — not routinely.

oneLiner.en: Preserving your best embryos safely, so the future stays open.

heroDescription.en: Embryo freezing means you can preserve the strongest embryos from your IVF cycle for later use — a future pregnancy, a second child, or simply the peace of mind of knowing they are there. Modern freezing technology is highly effective, and frozen embryos carry the same potential as fresh ones.

whatToExpect.en: The freezing step adds very little to the IVF process — it happens in the lab after your egg retrieval. A frozen embryo transfer cycle is much simpler than a full IVF cycle: you take medication to prepare the uterus lining, the embryo is thawed on the day of transfer, and the procedure itself is brief and gentle.

whoItsFor.en: Couples with remaining good-quality embryos after an IVF cycle
Those who want to delay transfer for health or personal timing reasons
Women at risk of ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS)
Anyone planning a second pregnancy from one retrieval cycle
Medical situations — such as illness or treatment — requiring a pause before transfer

detail.en: After your egg collection and fertilisation (from an IVF or ICSI cycle), our embryologist grades each embryo carefully. Those of good quality and development are selected for freezing.

Selected embryos are flash-frozen using vitrification — an ultra-rapid process that protects them from ice-crystal damage. Survival rates are above 95%, and the embryo is preserved at exactly the developmental stage it was at when frozen.

Frozen embryos are stored in secure, continuously monitored tanks. When you are ready, an embryo is gently thawed and transferred in a frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycle — simpler, gentler, and far less intensive than the original IVF retrieval.

q.en: Does freezing affect an embryo's quality or potential?

a.en: With modern vitrification, no. Survival rates are above 95% and the embryo is preserved at exactly the same biological developmental stage. In many studies, frozen transfers produce outcomes equal to or better than fresh transfers, because the uterus has had time to fully recover from stimulation.

q.en: How long can embryos stay frozen?

a.en: There is no medical expiry date. Healthy babies have been born from embryos frozen for more than ten years. You can keep them in storage for as long as you need, and the decision about what to do with them ultimately remains yours.

biography.en:
Dr. Gorakh Gopalkrishna Mandrupkar is a distinguished Reproductive Medicine and Infertility Specialist with over 20 years of experience in infertility management. He was awarded the Gold Medal in Gynecology by Pune University in 2004 and has been serving as a Consultant in Reproductive Medicine since March 2006.



Over the course of his career, Dr. Mandrupkar has helped more than 2,000 couples achieve successful pregnancies through advanced fertility treatments and personalized patient care.



Academic & Training Excellence

• Gold Medallist in Gynecology, Pune University (2004)

• Consultant in Reproductive Medicine since March 2006

• Over 20 years of experience in infertility management

• Successfully treated more than 2,000 infertile couples

• Director of a FOGSI-recognized IVF Training Centre for the past 10 years, where numerous gynecologists have received specialized training in IUI and IVF techniques.



Research & Innovation

Dr. Mandrupkar has made a significant contribution to maternal healthcare by developing the HDP Gestosis Score, a simple and innovative screening tool for identifying women at risk of preeclampsia (pregnancy-induced hypertension). Preeclampsia is a major cause of maternal mortality worldwide, accounting for nearly 19% of maternal deaths, according to WHO reports. The HDP Gestosis Score has been adopted by the National Health Mission (NHM), Government of India, for clinical use.



Know more about the Gestosis Score



Professional Leadership

Dr. Mandrupkar serves as an honorary member on various national committees of the Government of India and leading national organizations of gynecologists, contributing to the advancement of women's healthcare and reproductive medicine.



Commitment to Women's Health

In addition to providing comprehensive fertility care, Mandrupkar Clinic actively conducts clinical research aimed at improving women's health and advancing evidence-based reproductive medicine. The clinic remains committed to delivering ethical, innovative, and patient-centered care.

paragraphs.en: For Dr. Gorakh Mandrupkar, reproductive medicine has always involved two responsibilities: practising it carefully and making it understandable. He has worked as a consultant in reproductive medicine since March 2006, building more than two decades of experience around the questions couples bring into the consultation room.

His academic path includes a Pune University Gold Medal in Gynecology in 2004. Over time, that foundation expanded into clinical care for more than 2,000 couples, research in women's health, and more than ten years directing a FOGSI-recognized IVF training centre, where gynecologists train in IUI and IVF techniques.

The same practical curiosity led him to develop the HDP Gestosis Score, a screening tool for women at risk of preeclampsia that was adopted for clinical use by India's National Health Mission. He also serves as an honorary member on national committees of the Government of India and leading national associations of gynecologists. At the clinic, research and teaching are not separate from patient care; they shape how evidence is questioned, explained, and applied to each couple.

articles.title: Understanding IVF: a guide for your journey

title.en: Understanding IVF: a guide for your journey

excerpt.en: A plain-language, step-by-step guide to IVF — all six phases, from preparing your body to the pregnancy test — so you know exactly what to expect.
excerpt.mr: IVF चे सोप्या भाषेत, टप्प्याटप्प्याने मार्गदर्शन — शरीराच्या तयारीपासून गर्भधारणा चाचणीपर्यंतचे सहा टप्पे, म्हणजे तुम्हाला नेमकं काय अपेक्षित आहे ते कळेल.

intro1.en: Think of IVF as a way to help nature along. “In vitro” simply means “outside body” or in a laboratory. In short, we take eggs from the ovaries and mix them with sperm or inject the sperm in eggs (ICSI) in our lab to create embryos. We then place the healthiest embryo back into your uterus when it is ready for its acceptance.
intro1.mr: निसर्गाला मदत करण्याचा एक मार्ग म्हणून आय. व्ही. एफ. चा विचार करा. ‘इन विट्रो’ चा सरळ अर्थ ‘शरीराच्या बाहेर’ किंवा प्रयोगशाळेत असा होतो. थोडक्यात, आपण अंडाशयातून स्त्रीबीजे घेतो आणि त्यांना शुक्राणूंमध्ये मिसळतो किंवा भ्रूण तयार करण्यासाठी आपल्या प्रयोगशाळेत अंड्यांमध्ये शुक्राणू (आय. सी. एस. आय.) इंजेक्शन घेऊन भ्रूण तयार करतो. त्यानंतर जेव्हा ते अस्तर स्वीकृतीसाठी तयार असेल तेव्हा आम्ही सर्वात आरोग्यदायी भ्रूण तुमच्या गर्भाशयात ट्रान्सफर करतो.

en.heading: Phase 1 — Preparing your body
en.intro: Before we begin the actual IVF cycle, we need to understand your unique reproductive health. This preparation stage ensures we customise the treatment plan specifically for you.
en.intro2: Like plants, always good preparation of land before sowing the seeds gives the best yield, this phase is also very crucial.

items.label: Ovarian reserve testing
items.body: It is done by simple blood tests and pelvic ultrasound on day 2 or 3 of menses.

items.label: Semen analysis
items.body: We test a semen sample to check the count, shape, and movement of the sperm. You can see the them on screen.

items.label: Uterine exam
items.body: We examine the inside of your uterus using an ultrasound or a small 4 mm hysteroscope to ensure, the inner lining is safe to welcome an embryo.

items.label: Lifestyle modifications
items.body: We will ask you to start taking prenatal vitamins, maintain a balanced diet, avoid alcohol, and stop smoking.

en.heading: Phase 2 — Ovarian stimulation (growing the eggs)
en.intro: In a natural monthly cycle, your body usually matures just one or two eggs. For IVF, we want to grow multiple eggs at once to increase your chances of success.

items.label: Hormone injections
items.body: You can take these yourself, under the skin of your belly or thigh to encourage your ovaries to grow multiple egg follicles.

items.label: Regular monitoring
items.body: You will visit our clinic 2/3 times to monitor the progress. Along with blood tests and ultrasounds we will be able to watch the follicles grow and adjust your medication doses safely.

items.label: The trigger shot
items.body: Once the follicles reach the ideal size, you will take one final, precisely timed injection referred as “trigger shot” which will bring the eggs to full maturity, ready for collection.

en.note: No need of daily visits to clinic.

en.heading: Phase 3 — Egg retrieval (the collection)
en.intro: The egg retrieval is a minor surgical procedure performed at our clinic. It takes about 20 minutes, and you will not feel any pain during the process as it is done under a light anaesthetic or sedative so that you are completely asleep and comfortable.

items.label: Ultrasound guidance
items.body: I will insert a thin ultrasound probe into the vagina to clearly see your ovaries and the mature follicles.

items.label: Gentle suction
items.body: Using a very fine, specialized needle attached to the ultrasound probe, I gently draw the fluid—and the egg inside it—out of each follicle.

items.label: Recovery
items.body: You will rest for an hour or two and will be discharged same day.

en.heading: Phase 4 — Fertilisation and embryo development
en.intro: While you are resting from your retrieval, our embryologist takes over the next steps. This is where the magic happens behind the scenes over the next 3 to 6 days.

items.label: IVF with conventional insemination
items.body: We place thousands of healthy sperm in a dish alongside the retrieved eggs and let them fertilise naturally.

items.label: ICSI (intracytoplasmic sperm injection)
items.body: If the sperm count is low or weak, our embryologist will use a tiny needle to inject a single, healthy sperm directly into each mature egg to help it fertilise.

items.label: The incubation phase
items.body: The fertilised eggs become embryos. We place them in advanced incubators that mimic the warmth and environment of a human body, monitoring their growth as they divide into multiple cells.

en.heading: Phase 5 — The embryo transfer
en.intro: The embryo transfer is the simplest and most exciting part of the medical process.

items.label: Selecting the best embryo
items.body: Together, we will choose 1 or 2 healthiest embryos to transfer. Remaining high-quality embryos can be frozen for your future use.

items.label: The procedure
items.body: Under abdominal ultrasound guidance, embryo/s will be transferred using a very soft, smallest catheter. You can witness this live on screen.

items.label: Immediate return to routine
items.body: The transfer takes less than 10 minutes. You can get up right away, walk around, and go home to rest. You do not need strict bed rest, but we recommend avoiding heavy lifting or intense workouts and lumpy bumpy journey.

en.heading: Phase 6 — The 15 days wait
en.intro: The final phase requires the most patience. Correct and timely usage of progesterone medications along with other supportive medicines help embryo implant into the uterine lining naturally.

items.label: Managing anxiety
items.body: This waiting period can feel emotionally difficult. We encourage you to focus on light activities, stay connected with loved ones. Surrender to Supreme Nature and pamper yourself; this will help you to fulfil your dream of parenthood.

items.label: The official pregnancy test
items.body: In case of day 3 embryo transfer, the hormone HCG is measured in blood to confirm the pregnancy 16 days after the transfer. While, 14 days after in case of day 5 transfer.

mr.heading: टप्पा 1 — तुमच्या शरीराची तयारी
mr.intro: ( I.V.F ) सायकल सुरू करण्यापूर्वी शरीराची पूर्ण तयारी अत्यंत गरजेची असते.

items.label: AFC : Antral Follicle Count

items.body: शुक्राणूंची संख्या, आकार आणि हालचाल तपासण्यासाठी आपण वीर्य नमुन्याची चाचणी करतो. ते तुम्ही पडद्यावर पाहू शकता.

items.label: H's copy
items.body: गर्भाचे स्वागत करण्यासाठी आतील अस्तर सुरक्षित आहे याची खात्री करण्यासाठी आपण अल्ट्रासाऊंड किंवा 4 मिमीच्या छोट्या हिस्टेरोस्कोपचा वापर करून परिक्षण करतो.

items.label: जीवनशैलीतील बदल
items.body: आम्ही तुम्हाला प्रसूतीपूर्व जीवनसत्त्वे घेण्यास सुरुवात करण्यास, संतुलित आहार राखण्यास, अल्कोहोल टाळण्यास आणि धूम्रपान थांबविण्यास सांगू.

mr.heading: टप्पा 2 — अंडाशयातील स्त्रीबीजे
mr.intro: नैसर्गिक मासिक चक्रात, तुमचे शरीर सहसा फक्त एक किंवा दोन स्त्रीबीजे परिपक्व करते. आय. व्ही. एफ. साठी, तुमच्या यशाची शक्यता वाढवण्यासाठी आम्हाला एकाच वेळी अनेक स्त्रीबीजे वाढवायची आहेत.

items.label: हार्मोन इंजेक्शन्स
items.body: तुमच्या अंडाशयांना अनेक स्त्रीबीजे वाढवण्यास प्रोत्साहित करण्यासाठी तुम्ही हे तुमच्या पोटाच्या किंवा मांडीच्या त्वचेखाली स्वतः घेऊ शकता.

items.label: नियमित देखरेख
items.body: प्रगतीचे निरीक्षण करण्यासाठी आपण आमच्या क्लिनिकला 2/3 वेळा भेट द्याल. रक्त चाचण्या आणि अल्ट्रासाऊंडसह आपण स्त्रीबीजे वाढताना पाहू शकू आणि तुमच्या औषधाचे डोस सुरक्षितपणे नियमित करू शकू.

items.label: ट्रिगर शॉट
items.body: आम्ही सांगितल्यावर, तुम्ही “ट्रिगर शॉट” म्हणून ओळखले जाणारे एक अंतिम, अचूक वेळेचे इंजेक्शन घ्याल, जे स्त्रीबीजे पूर्ण परिपक्वतेपर्यंत आणेल आणि ovvm  pick up साठी तयार होईल.

mr.heading: टप्पा 3 — स्त्रीबीजे संकलन ( OPU )
mr.intro: एक छोटी शस्त्रक्रियेची प्रक्रिया आहे. याला सुमारे 20 मिनिटे लागतात आणि या प्रक्रियेदरम्यान तुम्हाला कोणतीही वेदना जाणवणार नाही कारण हे हलक्या भुलेच्या किंवा शामक औषधाखाली केले जाते जेणेकरून तुम्ही पूर्णपणे झोपलेले आणि आरामदायी असाल.

items.label: अल्ट्रासाऊंड मार्गदर्शन
items.body: योनी द्वारे सोनोग्राफी करून ही स्त्रीबीजे काढली जातात.

items.label: रिकवरी
items.body: साधारण चार ते पाच तासानंतर त्याच दिवशी डिस्चार्ज मिळेल.

mr.heading: टप्पा 4 — फर्टिलायझेशन आणि भ्रूण तयार होणे
mr.intro: तुम्ही पुनर्प्राप्तीपासून विश्रांती घेत असताना, आमचे भ्रूणशास्त्रज्ञ पुढील पावले उचलतात. येथूनच पुढील 3 ते 6 दिवसांत पडद्यामागील जादू घडते.

items.label: पारंपारिक डिशमध्ये स्त्री बीजांसोबत आय. व्ही. एफ..
items.body: आपण हजारो निरोगी शुक्राणू एका डिशमध्ये स्त्रीबीजे सोबत अंड्यांच्या बाजूला ठेवतो आणि त्यांना नैसर्गिकरित्या फलित करू देतो.

items.label: आय. सी. एस. आय. (इंट्रासायटोप्लाझ्मिक स्पर्म इंजेक्शन) ICSI
items.body: जर शुक्राणूंची संख्या कमी किंवा कमकुवत असेल, तर आपले भ्रूणशास्त्रज्ञ प्रत्येक स्त्रीबीजामध्ये थेट एक, निरोगी शुक्राणू चे इंजेक्शन करतील की जेणेकरून ते फलित होण्यास मदत होईल.

items.label: इनक्युबेशन टप्पा
items.body: फलित स्त्रीबीजे भ्रूण बनतात. आपण त्यांना प्रगत इनक्युबेटर्समध्ये ठेवतो जे मानवी शरीराच्या उबदारपणाची आणि वातावरणाची परिस्थिती निर्माण करतात.

mr.heading: टप्पा 5 — भ्रूण हस्तांतरण
mr.intro: हा वैद्यकीय प्रक्रियेचा सर्वात सोपा आणि सर्वात रोमांचक भाग आहे.

items.label: सर्वोत्तम भ्रूण निवडणे
items.body: एकत्रितपणे, आपण हस्तांतरित करण्यासाठी 1 किंवा 2 आरोग्यदायी भ्रूण निवडू. उर्वरित उच्च दर्जाचे भ्रूण तुमच्या भविष्यातील वापरासाठी गोठवले जाऊ शकतात.

items.label: प्रक्रिया
items.body: ओटीपोटाच्या अल्ट्रासाऊंड मार्गदर्शनाखाली, अत्यंत नाजूक, सर्वात लहान कॅथेटरचा वापर करून भ्रूण हस्तांतरित केले जाईल. तुम्ही हे सोनोग्राफी द्वारे थेट पाहू शकता.

items.label: रिकवरी
items.body: हस्तांतरणास 10 मिनिटांपेक्षा कमी वेळ लागतो. तुम्ही लगेच उठू शकता, फिरू शकता आणि आराम करण्यासाठी घरी जाऊ शकता. तुम्हाला विश्रांतीची गरज नाही, परंतु आम्ही जड उचलणे किंवा तीव्र व्यायाम आणि घाट युक्त चढउतारयुक्त प्रवास टाळण्याची शिफारस करतो.

mr.heading: टप्पा 6 — 15 दिवस प्रतीक्षा
mr.intro: अंतिम टप्प्यात सर्वात जास्त संयमाची आवश्यकता असते. इतर सहाय्यक औषधांसह प्रोजेस्टेरॉन औषधांचा योग्य आणि वेळेवर वापर केल्याने गर्भाचे गर्भाशयाच्या अस्तरामध्ये नैसर्गिकरित्या रोपण करण्यास मदत होते.

items.label: चिंतेचे व्यवस्थापन
items.body: हा प्रतीक्षा कालावधी भावनिकदृष्ट्या कठीण वाटू शकतो. आम्ही तुम्हाला आनंदी व ताण रहित राहण्यास आणि प्रियजनांच्या सानिध्यात राहण्यास प्रोत्साहित करतो.

items.label: अधिकृत गर्भधारणा चाचणी
items.body: day 3 भ्रूण हस्तांतरणाच्या बाबतीत, हस्तांतरणानंतर 16 दिवसांनी गर्भधारणा निश्चित करण्यासाठी रक्तात HCG हे हार्मोन मोजले जाते. तर, day 5 हस्तांतरणाच्या बाबतीत 14 दिवसांनी.

closingPara1.en: IVF is a physical journey, but it is also an emotional rollercoaster. Our entire clinical team, including our dedicated nursing staff and counsellors, are here to support you through every single step, question, and milestone.
closingPara1.mr: IVF हा एक शारीरिक प्रवास आहे, पण तो एक भावनिक चढ-उतारही आहे. आमची संपूर्ण क्लिनिकल टीम — आमच्या समर्पित नर्सिंग स्टाफ आणि समुपदेशकांसह — प्रत्येक टप्प्यावर, प्रत्येक प्रश्नात आणि प्रत्येक महत्त्वाच्या क्षणी तुमच्या पाठीशी आहे.

excerpt.en: A common, treatable hormonal condition that can affect your periods and fertility. The signs to watch for, why it happens, and how we treat it.
excerpt.mr: पीसीओएस ही एक सामान्य, उपचार करण्याजोगी हार्मोनल स्थिती आहे, जी मासिक पाळी आणि प्रजननक्षमतेवर परिणाम करू शकते. याची लक्षणे, कारणे आणि आम्ही त्यावर कसे उपचार करतो.

intro.en: PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome) — now also called PMOS (Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome). PCOS is a common condition that affects a woman's hormones. It can make periods irregular and may make it harder to become pregnant. It can also cause weight gain, acne, and extra hair growth on the face or body. PCOS can be treated, and most women with PCOS can live a healthy life.
intro.mr: पीसीओएस (पॉलीसिस्टिक ओव्हरी सिंड्रोम) — आता त्याला पी. एम. ओ. एस. (पॉलीएंडोक्राइन मेटाबॉलिक ओव्हेरियन सिंड्रोम) असे म्हणतात. पी. सी. ओ. एस. ही एक सामान्य स्थिती आहे जी स्त्रीच्या संप्रेरकांवर परिणाम करते. यामुळे मासिक पाळी अनियमित होऊ शकते आणि गर्भवती होणे कठीण होऊ शकते. यामुळे वजन वाढणे, मुरुम होणे आणि चेहऱ्यावर किंवा शरीरावर अतिरिक्त केस वाढणे देखील होऊ शकते. पी. सी. ओ. एस. वर उपचार केले जाऊ शकतात आणि पी. सी. ओ. एस. असलेल्या बहुतेक स्त्रिया निरोगी जीवन जगू शकतात.

Extra hair on the face, chest, or tummy

whyBody.en: The exact cause is not known. It may run in families. Many women with PCOS have a problem called insulin resistance, where the body does not use insulin properly. This can lead to weight gain and make PCOS symptoms worse.

lifestyleIntro.en: A healthy lifestyle is the most important treatment.
lifestyleIntro.mr: निरोगी जीवनशैली हा सर्वात महत्त्वाचा उपचार आहे.

en: Eat more vegetables, fruits, whole grains, pulses, and lean protein
Reduce sweets, sugary drinks, and junk food
Exercise for at least 30 minutes a day, 5 days a week
Losing even a small amount of weight can improve periods and increase the chance of pregnancy

Help you become pregnant if you are planning a baby

excerpt.en: Male-factor infertility is common and often very treatable. The causes, the simple checks, and what men can do to help.

intro.en: Male infertility means a man has trouble helping his partner become pregnant, even after trying for 1 year with regular unprotected sex.

Smoking, alcohol, drugs, or some medicines

अंडकोषांजवळ जास्त उष्णता निर्माण होईल अशा गोष्टी टाळा

If you have been trying for 1 year and no pregnancy
If you have pain or swelling in the testicles

जर तुम्ही १ वर्षापासून प्रयत्न करत असूनही गर्भधारणा होत नसेल

excerpt.en: Recurrent miscarriage — two or more losses — is more common than many realise, and a healthy pregnancy is often still possible.
excerpt.mr: वारंवार होणारा गर्भपात — दोन किंवा अधिक वेळा — अनेकांना वाटतं त्यापेक्षा अधिक सामान्य आहे, आणि अनेकदा निरोगी गर्भधारणा अजूनही शक्य असते. याची कारणे, चाचण्या आणि उपचार.

intro.en: Recurrent pregnancy loss means having two or more miscarriages. It is more common than many people realize, and in many cases, a healthy pregnancy is still possible.
intro.mr: वारंवार गर्भधारणा कमी होणे म्हणजे दोन किंवा अधिक गर्भपात होणे. बर्याच लोकांच्या लक्षात येण्यापेक्षा हे अधिक सामान्य आहे आणि बर्याच प्रकरणांमध्ये, निरोगी गर्भधारणा अजूनही शक्य आहे.

en.heading: Why does it happen?
items: Problems with the baby's chromosomes (most common)
Problems with the shape of the uterus
Hormone problems (such as thyroid disease or diabetes)
Certain blood-clotting or immune conditions
Sometimes, no cause is found

en.heading: What tests may be needed?
items: Blood tests for associated medical conditions
An ultrasound scan of the uterus
Tests for certain medical conditions
Special tests for APLAS, ANA, ENA or thrombophilia markers.
Sometimes, genetic tests for the couple or the pregnancy tissue

en.heading: Can it be treated?
en.intro: Yes. Treatment depends on the cause and may include:
items: Medicines for thyroid disease, diabetes, or blood-clotting disorders
Surgery to correct some uterine problems
Close monitoring during the next pregnancy

en.heading: What are the chances of a healthy baby?
en.body: The good news is that most women with recurrent pregnancy loss go on to have a healthy baby, especially with proper medical care and follow-up.

en.heading: When should you see a doctor?
en.body: If you have had two or more miscarriages, consult an obstetrician or fertility specialist for evaluation and advice.

mr.heading: असे का घडते?
items: बाळाच्या गुणसूत्रांमध्ये समस्या (सर्वात सामान्य)
गर्भाशयाच्या आकारात समस्या
संप्रेरक समस्या (उदाहरणार्थ थायरॉईड रोग किंवा मधुमेह)
काही रक्त गोठणे किंवा रोगप्रतिकारक स्थिती
कधीकधी, कोणतेही कारण सापडत नाही

mr.heading: कोणत्या चाचण्यांची आवश्यकता असू शकते?
items: संबंधित वैद्यकीय परिस्थितींसाठी रक्त चाचण्या
गर्भाशयाचे अल्ट्रासाऊंड स्कॅन
विशिष्ट वैद्यकीय परिस्थितींसाठी चाचण्या
एपीएलएएस, एएनए, ईएनए किंवा थ्रोम्बोफिलिया मार्करसाठी विशेष चाचण्या.
कधीकधी, जोडप्यासाठी किंवा गर्भधारणेच्या ऊतींसाठी अनुवांशिक चाचण्या

mr.heading: त्यावर उपचार करता येतील का?
mr.intro: होय. उपचार कारणावर अवलंबून असतो आणि त्यात खालील गोष्टींचा समावेश असू शकतोः
items: थायरॉईड रोग, मधुमेह किंवा रक्ताच्या गुठळ्या होण्याच्या विकारांसाठी औषधे
गर्भाशयाच्या काही समस्या सुधारण्यासाठी शस्त्रक्रिया
पुढील गर्भधारणेदरम्यान बारकाईने देखरेख

mr.heading: निरोगी बाळाची शक्यता किती आहे?
mr.body: चांगली बातमी अशी आहे की वारंवार गर्भधारणा गमावलेल्या बहुतेक स्त्रिया निरोगी बाळाला जन्म देतात, विशेषतः योग्य वैद्यकीय काळजी आणि पाठपुराव्यासह.

mr.heading: तुम्ही डॉक्टरकडे केव्हा जायला हवे?
mr.body: जर तुमचा दोन किंवा अधिक वेळा गर्भपात झाला असेल, तर मूल्यमापन आणि सल्ल्यासाठी प्रसूतिशास्त्रज्ञ किंवा प्रजनन तज्ञांचा सल्ला घ्या.

closing.en: Remember: Having recurrent miscarriages does not mean you cannot have a successful pregnancy. Early medical care and support can improve your chances.
closing.mr: लक्षात ठेवाः वारंवार गर्भपात होणे याचा अर्थ असा नाही की तुम्ही यशस्वी गर्भधारणा करू शकत नाही. लवकर वैद्यकीय सेवा आणि पाठबळ यामुळे तुमची शक्यता सुधारू शकते.

excerpt.en: All the tests come back normal, yet pregnancy is not happening. "Unexplained infertility" is not a diagnosis of nothing.
excerpt.mr: सर्व तपासण्या सामान्य येतात, तरीही गर्भधारणा होत नाही. 'कारण न सापडलेले वंध्यत्व' म्हणजे काहीच नाही असं नाही — याचा नेमका अर्थ काय आणि पुढे काय.

intro.en: Unexplained infertility means that a couple is having difficulty getting pregnant, even though all the routine fertility tests are normal.
intro.mr: वर्णन न केलेल्या वंध्यत्वाचा अर्थ असा आहे की जरी सर्व नियमित प्रजनन चाचण्या सामान्य असल्या तरी जोडप्याला गर्भवती होण्यास त्रास होत आहे.

en.heading: This means:
items: The woman's eggs are being released regularly (ovulation is normal).
The fallopian tubes are open.
The uterus looks healthy.
The man's sperm test is normal.

en.body: Even though everything appears normal, pregnancy is still not happening. This does not mean that pregnancy is impossible. It simply means that the exact reason cannot be found with the tests we have today.

en.heading: Can pregnancy still happen?
en.body: Yes. Many couples with unexplained infertility become pregnant naturally or with fertility treatment.

en.heading: What are the treatment options?
en.intro: Depending on your age and how long you have been trying, your doctor may suggest:
items: Trying naturally for a little longer.
Medicines to help improve the chances of pregnancy.
IUI (Intrauterine Insemination), where specially prepared sperm is placed inside the uterus.
IVF (Test Tube Baby) if other treatments are not successful.

mr.heading: याचा अर्थ असाः
items: महिलेची स्त्रीबीजे नियमितपणे सोडली जात आहेत (ओव्हुलेशन सामान्य आहे)
फेलोपियन नळ्या खुल्या असतात.
गर्भाशय निरोगी दिसते.
पुरुषाची शुक्राणूंची चाचणी सामान्य आहे.

mr.body: जरी सर्व काही सामान्य दिसत असले, तरीही गर्भधारणा होत नाही. याचा अर्थ असा नाही की गर्भधारणा अशक्य आहे. याचा सरळ अर्थ असा आहे की आज आपल्याकडे असलेल्या चाचण्यांमुळे नेमके कारण सापडत नाही.

mr.heading: अजूनही गर्भधारणा होऊ शकते का?
mr.body: होय. अस्पष्ट वंध्यत्व असलेली अनेक जोडपी नैसर्गिकरित्या किंवा प्रजननक्षमतेच्या उपचारांनी गर्भवती होतात.

mr.heading: उपचाराचे पर्याय काय आहेत?
mr.intro: तुमचे वय आणि तुम्ही किती काळापासून प्रयत्न करत आहात यावर अवलंबून, तुमचे डॉक्टर सुचवू शकतातः
items: थोडा वेळ नैसर्गिकरित्या प्रयत्न करा.
गर्भधारणेची शक्यता सुधारण्यासाठी औषधे.
आय. यू. आय. (अंतर्गर्भाशयी गर्भाधान) ज्यामध्ये विशेषतः तयार केलेले शुक्राणू गर्भाशयाच्या आत ठेवले जातात.
इतर उपचार यशस्वी न झाल्यास आय. व्ही. एफ. (टेस्ट ट्यूब बेबी).

closing.en: Important message: Having unexplained infertility does not mean you can never have a baby. It only means that the cause has not been identified with current tests. Your fertility specialist will guide you on the best treatment based on your age, medical history, and how long you have been trying to conceive.
closing.mr: महत्त्वाचा संदेश: अस्पष्ट वंध्यत्व याचा अर्थ असा नाही की तुम्ही कधीही बाळाला जन्म देऊ शकत नाही. याचा अर्थ असा आहे की सध्याच्या चाचण्यांद्वारे कारण ओळखले गेले नाही. तुमचे प्रजनन तज्ञ तुमचे वय, वैद्यकीय इतिहास आणि तुम्ही किती काळापासून गर्भधारणेचा प्रयत्न करत आहात यावर आधारित सर्वोत्तम उपचारांसाठी तुम्हाला मार्गदर्शन करतील.

excerpt.en: Age is one of the most important factors in fertility — but it is not the only one, and 40 is not a closed door.
excerpt.mr: वय हा प्रजननक्षमतेतील सर्वात महत्त्वाच्या घटकांपैकी एक आहे — पण तोच एकमेव घटक नाही, आणि चाळिशी म्हणजे बंद दरवाजा नाही.

intro.en: As women get older, it becomes harder to become pregnant naturally or through IVF. This is because both the number and quality of eggs decrease with age.
intro.mr: महिलांचे वय जसजसे वाढत जाते, तसतसे नैसर्गिकरित्या किंवा आय. व्ही. एफ. द्वारे गर्भवती होणे कठीण होते. याचे कारण असे की अंड्यांची संख्या आणि गुणवत्ता दोन्ही वयानुसार कमी होतात.

en.heading: Common Challenges in IVF with Increasing Age
items: Fewer eggs are available during treatment.
Eggs may not fertilize as well.
Fewer healthy embryos are formed.
Lower chance of embryo implantation.
Higher chance of miscarriage.
More than one IVF cycle may be needed.
Pregnancy complications, such as high blood pressure and diabetes, are more common in older mothers.

en.heading: What Can Help?
items: Do not delay fertility treatment if you are planning a pregnancy.
Maintain a healthy weight, eat a balanced diet, exercise regularly, and avoid smoking and alcohol.
Follow your doctor's advice regarding medications and treatment.
In some cases, genetic testing of embryos or using donor eggs may improve the chance of a healthy pregnancy.

mr.heading: वाढत्या वयाबरोबर आय. व्ही. एफ. मधील सामान्य आव्हाने
items: उपचारादरम्यान कमी स्त्रीबीजे उपलब्ध होतात.
स्त्रीबीजे देखील फलित होऊ शकत नाहीत.
कमी निरोगी भ्रूण तयार होतात.
भ्रूण प्रत्यारोपणाची शक्यता कमी.
गर्भपात होण्याची शक्यता जास्त असते.
एकापेक्षा जास्त आय. व्ही. एफ. चक्रांची आवश्यकता असू शकते.
उच्च रक्तदाब आणि मधुमेह यासारख्या गर्भधारणेच्या गुंतागुंती वृद्ध मातांमध्ये अधिक सामान्य आहेत.

mr.heading: काय मदत होऊ शकते?
items: जर तुम्ही गर्भधारणेचे नियोजन करत असाल तर प्रजननक्षमतेच्या उपचारांना विलंब करू नका.
निरोगी वजन ठेवा, संतुलित आहार घ्या, नियमित व्यायाम करा आणि धूम्रपान आणि अल्कोहोल टाळा.
औषधे आणि उपचारांबाबत तुमच्या डॉक्टरांच्या सल्ल्याचे पालन करा.
काही प्रकरणांमध्ये, गर्भांची जनुकीय चाचणी किंवा दात्याची स्त्रीबीजे वापरणे निरोगी गर्भधारणेची शक्यता सुधारू शकते.

mr.heading: आईच्या वयानुसार आय. व्ही. एफ. च्या यशाचे वैशिष्ट्यपूर्ण कल (स्वतःची स्त्रीबीजे वापरून)

headers: प्रति आय. व्ही. एफ. चक्र सामान्य जिवंत जन्माची शक्यता *

mr.body: या अंदाजे श्रेणी आहेत आणि चिकित्सालय, निदान, गर्भाची गुणवत्ता आणि वैयक्तिक आरोग्यानुसार बदलतात.

closing.en: Key Message: Age is one of the most important factors affecting IVF success. Starting treatment earlier generally gives a better chance of pregnancy. However, every woman is different, and many women still achieve successful pregnancies with the right treatment and care.
closing.mr: मुख्य संदेश: आय. व्ही. एफ. च्या यशावर परिणाम करणाऱ्या सर्वात महत्त्वाच्या घटकांपैकी वय हा एक घटक आहे. लवकर उपचार सुरू केल्याने सामान्यतः गर्भधारणेची अधिक चांगली शक्यता असते. तथापि, प्रत्येक स्त्री वेगळी असते आणि तरीही अनेक स्त्रिया योग्य उपचार आणि काळजी घेऊन यशस्वी गर्भधारणा साध्य करतात.

excerpt.en: Myths about IVF spread faster than facts. Here is what is actually true — in plain language, without the dramatics.
excerpt.mr: IVF बद्दलचे गैरसमज तथ्यांपेक्षा वेगाने पसरतात. प्रत्यक्षात खरं काय आहे ते — सोप्या भाषेत, नाट्यमयता न आणता.

intro.en: Myths about IVF travel fast — and they often cause more worry than they need to. Here are ten of the most common ones, and what is actually true.
intro.mr: IVF बद्दलचे गैरसमज पटकन पसरतात — आणि अनेकदा गरजेपेक्षा जास्त काळजी निर्माण करतात. इथे असे दहा सर्वात सामान्य गैरसमज, आणि प्रत्यक्षात खरं काय आहे ते.

en.fact: IVF gives hope, but it does not guarantee pregnancy. Success depends on factors like age, egg quality, sperm quality, and overall health.
Fertility problems can happen in both men and women. IVF can help when the problem is with the woman, the man, or both.
Not anymore. Today, doctors often transfer just one healthy embryo, so most IVF pregnancies result in a single baby.
IVF babies are just as healthy and loved as naturally conceived babies. Millions of healthy IVF babies have been born worldwide.
Most women feel only mild discomfort. The egg collection procedure is done under anesthesia, so you won't feel pain during it.
Feeling worried or emotional is normal. Stress alone does not cause IVF to fail, but taking care of your mental health is important.

en.myth: You need complete bed rest after embryo transfer.
en.fact: No. Normal daily activities are safe. Your doctor may only ask you to avoid heavy exercise or lifting.
Age is one of the most important factors. Younger eggs usually have a better chance of leading to a healthy pregnancy.
Current research shows no strong evidence that IVF treatment causes cancer.

en.myth: A healthy lifestyle doesn't matter during IVF.
en.fact: Eating healthy, getting enough sleep, avoiding smoking/ alcohol will improve results.

mr.myth: आय. व्ही. एफ. नेहमीच काम करते.
mr.fact: आय. व्ही. एफ. आशा देते, परंतु गर्भधारणेची हमी देत नाही. यश हे वय, अंड्याची गुणवत्ता, शुक्राणूंची गुणवत्ता आणि एकूण आरोग्य यासारख्या घटकांवर अवलंबून असते.

mr.myth: आय. व्ही. एफ. फक्त महिलांसाठी आहे.
mr.fact: प्रजननक्षमतेच्या समस्या पुरुष आणि स्त्रिया दोघांमध्येही उद्भवू शकतात. जेव्हा समस्या स्त्री, पुरुष किंवा दोघांमध्ये असेल तेव्हा आय. व्ही. एफ. मदत करू शकते.

mr.myth: आय. व्ही. एफ. मुळे नेहमीच जुळी मुले होतात.
mr.fact: आता नाही. आज, डॉक्टर अनेकदा फक्त एक निरोगी गर्भ हस्तांतरित करतात, त्यामुळे बहुतेक आय. व्ही. एफ. गर्भधारणेमुळे एकच बाळ होते.

mr.myth: आय. व्ही. एफ. ची बाळं निरोगी नसतात.
mr.fact: आय. व्ही. एफ. ची बाळं तितकीच निरोगी असतात आणि नैसर्गिकरित्या गर्भधारणा झालेल्या बाळांप्रमाणेच त्यांना आवडतात. जगभरात लाखो निरोगी आय. व्ही. एफ. बाळांचा जन्म झाला आहे.

mr.myth: आय. व्ही. एफ. खूप वेदनादायक आहे.
mr.fact: बहुतेक स्त्रियांना फक्त सौम्य अस्वस्थता जाणवते. स्त्रीबीजे गोळा करण्याची प्रक्रिया भूल देऊन केली जाते, त्यामुळे तुम्हाला त्या दरम्यान वेदना जाणवणार नाहीत.

mr.myth: तणावामुळे आय. व्ही. एफ. अपयशी ठरतो.
mr.fact: चिंतेत किंवा भावनिक वाटणे हे सामान्य आहे. केवळ तणावामुळे आय. व्ही. एफ. अयशस्वी होत नाही, परंतु तुमच्या मानसिक आरोग्याची काळजी घेणे महत्वाचे आहे.

mr.myth: भ्रूण हस्तांतरणानंतर तुम्हाला पूर्ण विश्रांतीची गरज आहे.
mr.fact: नाही. सामान्य दैनंदिन कामे सुरक्षित असतात. तुमचे डॉक्टर तुम्हाला जड उचलणे आणि पोटाचे व्यायाम टाळण्यास सांगतील.

mr.myth: आय व्ही एफ मध्ये वयाने काही फरक पडत नाही.
mr.fact: जास्त वयाच्या स्त्रीच्या बीजांद्वारे निरोगी गर्भधारणेची शक्यता कमी असते.

mr.myth: आय. व्ही. एफ. मुळे कर्करोग होतो.
mr.fact: आय. व्ही. एफ. उपचारांमुळे कर्करोग होतो याचा कोणताही ठोस पुरावा सध्याच्या संशोधनात दिसून येत नाही.

mr.myth: आय. व्ही. एफ. दरम्यान निरोगी जीवनशैली महत्त्वाची नाही.
mr.fact: निरोगी खाणे, पुरेशी झोप घेणे, धूम्रपान/अल्कोहोल टाळणे यामुळे परिणाम सुधारतील.

closing.en: Talk to us and the supporting team to understand the treatment plan that is best for you.
closing.mr: तुमच्यासाठी सर्वोत्तम असलेली उपचार योजना समजून घेण्यासाठी आमच्याशी आणि सहाय्यक चमूशी बोला.

body.en: If something here has been on your mind, you’re not alone — these are the things couples ask us most. Honest answers, in plain language.
body.mr: इथलं काही तुमच्याही मनात असेल, तर तुम्ही एकटे नाही — हेच प्रश्न दाम्पत्यं आम्हाला सर्वात जास्त विचारतात. प्रामाणिक उत्तरं, सोप्या भाषेत.

closeBody.en: Still wondering about something? The best answers are the ones about your situation.
closeBody.mr: अजूनही काही मनात आहे का? सर्वात चांगली उत्तरं तुमच्या परिस्थितीबद्दलचीच असतात.

question.en: Are IVF babies as healthy as other babies?
question.mr: IVF मधून जन्मलेली बाळं इतर बाळांइतकीच निरोगी असतात का?

answer.en: Yes. Millions of healthy children have been born through IVF worldwide. An IVF baby is just as healthy — and just as loved — as any other.
answer.mr: होय. जगभरात IVF मधून लाखो निरोगी मुलं जन्माला आली आहेत. IVF बाळ इतर कोणत्याही बाळाइतकंच निरोगी — आणि तितकंच लाडकं — असतं.

question.mr: IVF म्हणजे नेहमी जुळीच बाळं का?

answer.en: Not anymore. We usually transfer a single healthy embryo, so most IVF pregnancies are a single baby.
answer.mr: आता नाही. आम्ही सहसा एकच निरोगी embryo ट्रान्सफर करतो, त्यामुळे बहुतेक IVF गर्भधारणांमध्ये एकच बाळ असतं.

answer.en: Most people feel only mild discomfort. The egg-collection step is done under anesthesia, so you won’t feel pain during it.
answer.mr: बहुतेकांना फक्त थोडासा त्रास जाणवतो. स्त्री बीजे गोळा करण्याचा टप्पा भूल देऊन केला जातो, त्यामुळे त्या वेळी वेदना जाणवत नाहीत.

question.en: Is IVF only about the woman?
question.mr: IVF फक्त स्त्रीशीच संबंधित असतं का?

answer.en: No. Fertility challenges are just as often related to the man — or both partners. We look at the whole picture, together, without blame.
answer.mr: नाही. प्रजननातील अडचणी तितक्याच वेळा पुरुषाशी — किंवा दोघांशी — संबंधित असतात. आम्ही संपूर्ण चित्र एकत्रितपणे पाहतो, कुणालाही दोष न देता.

answer.en: It’s one of the most important factors — which is exactly why understanding your options early gives you the most choices. But every story is different, and 40 is not a closed door.
answer.mr: हो, ते सर्वात महत्त्वाच्या घटकांपैकी एक आहे — आणि म्हणूनच लवकर पर्याय समजून घेतल्याने तुम्हाला सर्वाधिक पर्याय मिळतात. पण प्रत्येकाची कहाणी वेगळी असते, आणि 40 म्हणजे बंद दरवाजा नाही.

question.en: Do I need complete bed rest after the embryo transfer?
question.mr: Embryo transfer नंतर मला पूर्ण बेड रेस्ट घ्यावी लागते का?

answer.en: No. Normal daily life is safe. We may simply ask you to avoid heavy lifting or intense exercise for a short while.
answer.mr: नाही. रोजचं सामान्य जीवन सुरक्षित असतं. फक्त काही काळ जड वजन उचलणं किंवा जोरदार व्यायाम टाळायला आम्ही सांगू शकतो.

answer.en: With a conversation — no commitment. We listen to your story, answer your questions, and only then talk about what (if anything) comes next.
answer.mr: एका संवादाने — कोणतंही बंधन नाही. आम्ही तुमची कहाणी ऐकतो, तुमच्या प्रश्नांची उत्तरं देतो, आणि त्यानंतरच पुढे काय (आणि काही असल्यास) याबद्दल बोलतो.

title.en: When the path feels uncertain, understanding is a form of care.

quote.en: Hope is most useful when it comes with clarity.

note.en: The original purpose of IVF Master was to educate couples about IVF and remove misconceptions around treatment.

paragraphs.en: Many couples arrive with more questions than answers. They may have spent months reading, waiting, or hearing advice that does not fit their story. Before another recommendation is made, they deserve to understand what their evaluation means.

IVF Master was conceived as a place for education as much as treatment: a place to explain fertility medicine in plain language, correct misconceptions, and help couples make informed decisions without pressure.
That belief shapes the clinical relationship. The team listens first, explains what is known, speaks honestly about what remains uncertain, and only then discusses the care that may be appropriate.

title.en: A plan is built with you, not handed to you.

intro.en: The medical work matters. So does the order in which it happens.

body.en: Your history, concerns, previous treatment, health, and hopes provide the context that tests alone cannot.
Evaluation may include ovarian reserve testing, semen analysis, uterine assessment, and lifestyle guidance. Each finding is explained before it becomes a decision.
Age, diagnosis, medical history, time trying to conceive, and individual priorities all influence which next step makes sense.
Questions do not stop when treatment starts. Support continues through monitoring, procedures, the waiting period, and pregnancy care where appropriate.

title.en: What you can expect from the relationship.

intro.en: Trust is not a claim made once. It is built through the way each conversation, recommendation, and uncertainty is handled.

body.en: A treatment plan follows an understanding of reproductive health, medical history, age, and the couple's circumstances.
Options are explained in plain language so consent is informed and couples can ask questions without feeling rushed.
Research and established reproductive medicine guide care, while the plan remains specific to the person rather than a standard protocol.
IVF can help, but it cannot promise pregnancy. Outcomes vary, and difficult facts are discussed with the same care as encouraging ones.
Care continues through treatment questions, the waiting period, follow-up, and pregnancy management when it is needed.
